intro: We support Bangkok charity programs, including projects run by the Rotary Club of Bangkok Foundation.
Supporting clean drinking water systems, sanitation, and hygiene education for rural schools and communities.
Rotary nursing scholarships help students in financial hardship and support Thailand’s need for registered nurses.
Helping stateless children access preparatory education, Thai language support, and safer pathways into school.
Supporting waste-management learning, sorting bins, composting, and reusable water bottles at a rural school.
Choose the Rotary category you prefer, or let the foundation allocate support where it is most helpful.

intro: We support Chiang Mai charity projects, primarily via the Chiang Mai International Rotary Club, including children, education, health, water safety, community wellbeing and practical support programs.
We also work with many other charity groups and would love to hear from others so we can support your charity.
Supporting water survival training for local students, helping children build basic swimming and ocean-safety skills.
Helping provide support and accommodation for patients and families who travel to Chiang Mai for medical treatment.
Supporting education pathways and opportunities for young people through GED learning and wider community education.
Screening school children for eyesight issues and helping children access spectacles so poor vision does not hold back learning.
Helping students build confidence, discipline and non-violent conflict resolution through peace-culture education.
Collecting and distributing winter clothing and school supplies for communities that need practical seasonal support.
